No old numeric PID becomes recovery authority. Normal timeout/TERM-ignore is still required to actively settle, so exception preservation is not substituted for successful cleanup.

Forged/cross-supervisor/released handle cannot reconcile; two real reconciliation/close calls share one settlement.
Fresh disappearance plus true parent drain permits exactly one FAILED_SETTLED rejection and release; ordinary seek/JOB paths do not stay pending.

Bridge and supervisor reuse the same active issued scope, and a direct call goes through the same scheduler. This removes the earlier B-duration-write window during A POST. The new read-side root-quiescence query is explicitly narrow and cannot invalidate the generic production lease used by record/serving/final activation.

Distinct roots overlap in actual independent groups, and the peer succeeds through A timeout.

Released scope in a late ALS continuation is refused; nested bridge/factory work does not recursively acquire the root lock.

prior_findings.reason: An irreversible ordered FINALIZE_AFTER_OK record is based on a complete validated candidate before requesting termination; no result is inferred from exit0/SIGKILL. Previously observed unexpected exit, native/protocol/cancel/output failure and final source drift prevent delivery; unknown identity or cleanup returns to the barrier. The truth table expressly limits its claim to observed authorized finalization, not unique causal attribution between racing signal sources.

Candidate then authorized forced finalize can succeed only after all settlement and witness gates; it is logged as forced finalization, not graceful exit0.
Late cancel/source drift overrides saved candidate; finalization cannot be backfilled after close.

scope_and_read_quiescence.no_self_lock: Only workspace outer production or direct entry acquires; nested factory/bridge/supervisor validates and reuses the issued scope. A final check does not wait for the scope it already owns.
scope_and_read_quiescence.no_authority_waiver: Physical root scheduling/quiescence never replaces owner/base/control/ref/generation/rights checks. A busy flag is a negative read condition, never a grant.
scope_and_read_quiescence.no_self_invalidation: Generic production lease.assertCurrent remains usable while that same production owns the root; quiescence is a separate read-only predicate.
scope_and_read_quiescence.read_guard_placement: Query the authenticated held root synchronously at read admission, at the final no-await delivery fence after reentrant liveness callbacks, and in retained proof verifyClosure. Busy or cleanup-required means unconfirmed/refusal, not another proof or a wait under the production mutex.
scope_and_read_quiescence.close_order: Stop new draw admission immediately; preserve resources needed by an already accepted executing draw. Freeze new HTTP/file/probe resources only at the post-domain-disappearance drain gate; then await existing sources/probes. Never close the listener early to fabricate settlement.
